s.g: Suffix added to stems to show that it does something; a doer.
alpha helix (secondary structure found in many proteins)
swede, rutabaga (Brassica napus, sometimes Brassica napus rapifera, plant and vegetable)
to place a wreath/garland on someone's head, to crown
to crown; to be the crowning achievement (of)
slungshot, single-headed meteor hammer (a weapon consisting of a weight attached to a rope, belt, or chain)
stupidity, foolishness, foolery, nonsense (quality of being stupid)
to be curious, to ask, to pry
to be born in some (often large) quantity
to yield to, to give in, to fall for, to cave in
to hold back (in a game), to intentionally let the opponent win or take the upper hand
psycho, lunatic, psychopath (a person who is psychotic or otherwise insane).
nut (a person who acts in a bizarre or dangerous manner)
state of being angry; madness; being in a rash (often used when speaking about children)
to match up, to compare, to contrast (with)
passing over in silence; failure to mention; reticence; non-disclosure
